question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution promotes the spread and development of Hindi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 351**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 351** of the Indian Constitution is specifically aimed at promoting the spread and development of the Hindi language.
 
• It directs the Union Government to promote Hindi so that it may serve as a medium of expression for all elements of the composite culture of India.
 
• The article also highlights the importance of assimilating forms, styles, and expressions from other Indian languages to enrich Hindi.
 
• It aims to make Hindi the lingua franca while respecting linguistic diversity and ensuring inclusivity in India’s cultural and linguistic heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Constitution and Language:**

 
 
• Part XVII of the Constitution deals with the official language of the Republic of India.
 
• Articles 343 to 351 specifically focus on language-related provisions.
 
 
 
• **Article 343:**
 
 
• Declares Hindi in the Devanagari script as the official language of the Union.
 
• English was permitted to be used for official purposes for an initial period of 15 years after the Constitution came into effect.
 
 
 
• **Article 350:**
 
 
• Allows individuals to submit representations for the redress of grievances in any language used in the Union or the state.
 
 
 
• **Efforts to Promote Hindi:**
 
 
• Institutions such as Kendriya Hindi Sansthan and Central Hindi Directorate work to implement the provisions of Article 351.
 
• Various schemes and awards are introduced by the government to promote the use of Hindi.
